witnesses.explanation: Equal match points: higher cumulative adjusted differential ranks first.
Match points take priority over differential.
Equal match points and differential share competition rank despite different raw totals, names and seeds.
Two negative differentials are ordered numerically, with the less negative first.
Overtime-adjusted differential reverses the raw-differential order.
A large win and narrow losses accumulate, but several narrow wins still earn higher match-point priority.
An exact standings tie includes a decisive head-to-head result and different opponent points; neither separates the rank.
